title: The Jelly That Learned to Split
story: In the moonlit tidepools, Morrowdrench the Tidepool Jelly splits into 3 copies of itself every single hour, and each copy splits too. Right now, at midnight, there is exactly 1 jelly, and the tide comes in at 5 o'clock. Mr 6 sits on a barnacled rock with a stick of chalk instead of drawing his sword.
question: If 1 jelly triples every hour, how many jellies will there be after 5 hours?
hint: Start with 1 and multiply by 3 once for each hour: 1, 3, 9... keep going to hour five.
victory: Mr 6 chalked '243' on the rock and Morrowdrench, horrified at being so thoroughly predicted, refused to split again and settled for being one very shiny jelly.
imagePrompt: Glowing blue jellyfish-like blobs multiplying across moonlit tidepools on a rocky shore, a small knight numeral six calmly writing numbers on a wet rock with chalk.
